title: Level is the only lever on who fights
body: Deployment order is by combat power, not ATK, and combat power follows level, so players raise the 40 they want and lower everything else. Unwanted cookies go to Lv.1 (ND러너) or just below the 40th-place cutoff (EOG, VART). Since 2026-09-23 a long press on level-up opens a fine control, which is how the levels are typed in.

title: Pomegranate's beam picks by synergy, then by ATK
body: Pomegranate's Skill AMP beam (석류빔, 빨대) goes first to cookies carrying the Projectile Speed synergy, which is why Milk always gets it, then by live ATK. Every other Projectile Speed recipient in the 40 would take it, so they are levelled out; the chosen dealers and buffers are ranked by lowering levels. Top lineups beam Scorpion, Brightseeker, Figure and Macaron; ND러너 found giving it to Macaron and Figure (buffers) scored best. EOG calls the synergy-first reading unconfirmed; an English guide restating ND러너's method calls it observed behaviour to verify.

title: Milk is the engine: captain, top ATK, centre of the formation
body: Milk (the pediatrician) is captain in every documented top run and must hold the highest ATK counting the captain's +10%, so Passion Pay and Rapid Promotion land on it. Its stacking ATK buff has a range, so the formation must stay packed and Milk must reach the centre early: players report high scores when Milk arrives at once and low ones when it trails in from the back (about 53 s on the countdown is 'early').

title: Stacked buffs since 9/10
body: Before the 2026-09-10 update a new buff of the same type replaced a stacked one, so Cheesecake's ATK buff erased Milk's stacks and Lime erased Macaron's; lineups left both out. The update made the stronger stacked value win, and by 9/21 players rated Cheesecake's ATK buff reaching Milk as one of the two things that matter most; the 325.9G run keeps Cheesecake sixth in ATK.

title: Chargers and summoners break the formation
body: Chargers dash past and around the boss; Milk and the healers follow them (heals go to the lowest-HP ally), so the ranged dealers behind lose every buff. Summoners spread the formation the same way. They are levelled out of the 40 (the Exclusions page lists them, Princess Bari among them since 9/23). Figure and Vampire are the chargers still kept because they stay at the boss. Some fillers (Red Pepper, Dark Cherry) are kept on purpose to draw Milk forward.

title: The Holy Golden Drop's patterns
body: The wiki lists the Holy Golden Drop's attacks: a floor squash that knocks cookies back, lightning strikes, and summoned Golden Soldier Drops. Players describe a slam around 20 s left that kills weak buffers, a jump attack that knocks cookies around, and a sweep that wipes the team near the end (about 15 s left at lower power, 8 s at higher). EOG's simulator models the shockwave as throwing the team back four times, the adds' damage as scoring nothing, and the boss raising its own damage reduction three times (stacking to five), so the first thirteen seconds decide a run; that part is EOG's model.

title: Conquest-only effects don't apply
body: Tea Knight's boss-damage buff works only in Guild Conquest, so it gives nothing here; focus still matters for Devil's and Dark Choco's DEF shred.

title: Mercenary perks
body: At mercenary Lv.4: Passion Pay (the highest-ATK ally, Milk) with Rapid Promotion (most posters) or Like A Family (elemental damage per cookie of the most-fielded element; ND러너's best, and 서신우 fills free slots with one element for it). At Lv.3 Rapid Promotion alone; below that the all-stats perk. One poster ran ATK 20% with '5사격'.

title: No pet selection
body: The dungeon has no pet slots to choose; EOG reads pets' passive effects and Collection bonuses as applying to every cookie anyway, and pets' ATK bonuses shift the ATK order.

title: KR and global share the servers
body: Rankings are per server, not merged. Korean players' boards show English- and Chinese-named rivals, and EOG (a global guild) reports from 'Server 1': there is one client (1.4.002) and one server list, so KR and global differ only in their communities' sources. Weekly participation runs from a few dozen to about 320 players per server.
